record.description: Oberlo is a platform that facilitates dropshipping by connecting Shopify merchants with suppliers who ship products directly to consumers. It simplifies the process for entrepreneurs to import products into their Shopify stores and manage order fulfillment with minimal effort. With its operations centered in Vilnius, Berlin, and Shenzhen, Oberlo empowers entrepreneurs to launch and run their online businesses efficiently.
